list.title: Accounts
list.description: Every account on the platform, independent of workspace membership.
list.loadErrorTitle: The user directory could not be loaded.
list.loadErrorDescription: Check the auth service and that your session still holds the platform admin role.
list.emptyDescription: Clear the search or pick a different status tab.

detail.notFoundDescription: No account carries this id. It may have been permanently removed, or the link is wrong.
detail.loadErrorTitle: This account could not be loaded
detail.loadErrorDescription: Check the auth service, and that your session still holds the platform admin role.

emailConfirmed.label: Email confirmed
emailConfirmed.hint: Whether the person has ever completed the verification link.

signInAllowed.label: Sign-in allowed
signInAllowed.hint: Deactivating also ends every session already open.

lockout.label: Failed-login lockout
lockout.hintLocked: Clears itself at {time}. Unlock does not wait for it.
lockout.hintClear: A lockout is temporary and clears itself once the window passes.

detail.sessionsOpenCount: {count, plural, =0 {none open} other {# open right now}}
detail.noSessionsOpen: No sessions are open. The account is not signed in anywhere.
detail.footerNote: A session row never carries the token or its hash — an administrator needs to know a session exists, not to be able to use it. Ending sessions does not lock the account or change the password: the person can sign in again immediately.

revokeSessions.title: End every session?
revokeSessions.description: Signs the account out everywhere. It is not locked and the password is unchanged — the person can sign in again immediately.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this account?
deactivate.description: The person cannot sign in, and the sessions already open are ended. Nothing is deleted and this can be undone.

reactivate.title: Reactivate this account?
reactivate.description: Sign-in is allowed again. Sessions ended earlier stay ended — the person signs in fresh.

unlock.title: Clear the lockout?
unlock.description: Removes a failed-login lockout and resets the attempt counter, so the person can try again now instead of waiting out the window.

actionDialog.noSessionsOpen: No sessions are open right now.
actionDialog.sessionsWillEnd: {count, plural, one {# session will end.} other {# sessions will end.}}
actionDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Recorded in the platform audit log against your account.
actionDialog.reasonTooShort: Give a reason of at least ten characters. It goes into the platform audit log.
actionDialog.genericError: Nothing was changed — the action could not be completed.
